$comment: Old English-sentence key (v1.x / 2.0.0-beta.0) -> namespaced key (2.0). Hand-reviewed; nothing regenerates it. An unmapped key fails SILENTLY: it never matches, so the override stops applying and English renders with no error. `split` means one old key became several whole sentences; `added` lists keys that had no v1 equivalent because they were resolved from a runtime value and were never translatable.

Anonymous.note: Called as t('Anonymous', { count }) at CallParticipantListHeader.tsx:29, but the catalog entry has no _one/_other forms, so i18next selects a plural key that does not exist. The copy does not vary with number. Edit the call site to drop the magic `count` variable and pass `{ anonymousCount }` instead; the new copy is ', and ({{ anonymousCount }}) anonymous' with no plural forms.

{{ count }} participants joined early.note: At LivestreamLayout.tsx:234 `count` is passed through humanize() when humanizeParticipantCount is set, so it can be a string like "1.2K" and i18next cannot run plural selection on it. Edit the call site to pass both variables: `count` stays the raw number (used for plural selection only) and a new `formattedCount` carries the display string (humanized or not). Copy becomes _one: '{{ formattedCount }} participant joined early', _other: '{{ formattedCount }} participants joined early'.
